changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE artifact DROP INDEX uq_document_artifact_kind, ADD COLUMN document_projection_kind VARCHAR(32) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN artifact_kind IN ('DOCUMENT_BODY','DOCUMENT_FIELDS','DOCUMENT_EVIDENCE') THEN artifact_kind ELSE NULL END) STORED, ADD UNIQUE KEY uq_document_projection_identity (tenant_id,project_id,document_revision,document_projection_kind)
